blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: problem recognition — Identify the underlying task type.
constraint — Requirement a solution must obey.
objective function — Quantity to minimise or maximise.
computable specification — Precise task that a program can implement/check.

blocks.title: Identify
blocks.text: A solvable computational problem needs an adequately precise input representation, a finite method and a verifiable output or objective.

blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: Problem recognition identifies the class of task—classification, searching, route finding, scheduling or optimisation—before selecting a method.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Define measurable success criteria and constraints; vague goals such as 'best route' require clarification of 'best' (distance, cost or time).

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the decision
blocks.text: Cost is defined and connections must be valid; output stops and total fare.
